Identification of DEGs in the carbon metabolic pathway and NR biosynthesis pathway, and differentially accumulated metabolites

Identification of DEGs in the carbon metabolic pathway and NR biosynthesis pathway, and differentially accumulated metabolites. (a) The schematic of the carbon metabolic pathway and NR biosynthesis pathway and expressions of DEGs encoding structural enzymes of these pathways, sugar signalling and transport in 1‐sst1‐fft and WT. Expression levels for each gene in 1‐sst1‐fft and WT were shown by heatmap using FPKM. Each value represents the mean of three biological replicates. FPKM, fragments per kilobase of transcript per million fragments mapped. (b) Heatmaps of carbohydrate accumulation in the roots of 1‐sst1‐fft and WT. Three biological replicates of 1‐sst1‐fft mutants (sf‐1, sf‐2 and sf‐3) and WT (WT‐1, WT‐2 and WT‐3) plants at ~200 DAC were used for analysis. The normalised signal intensities of sugar contents (unit variance scaling) were visualised as a colour spectrum and presented as heatmaps using hierarchical cluster analysis. Upregulated sugars are indicated by red asterisks, and downregulated sugars are indicated by blue asterisks. Ribose: D‐ribose; GlcNAc: 2‐Ace‐2‐Deo‐D‐glucosamine; Raf: Raffinose; Fru: Fructose; Cel: Cellobiose; Suc: Sucrose; Lac: Lactose. (c) Heatmaps of differentially accumulated terpenoids in the roots of 1‐sst1‐fft mutants and WT. Differentially accumulated metabolites were determined by VIP > 1, fold change ≥ 3, and p < 0.01. Monoterpenoids, sesquiterpenoids, diterpenoids, triterpenes and terpenes are highlighted in blue, green, yellow, orange and black font, respectively
